name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: Who had denied and turned away

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: But the righteous one will avoid it

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

name: Al-Layl · الليل
ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: And he is going to be satisfied

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: By the morning brightness

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: And He found you lost and guided [you]

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]

name: Ad-Duhaa · الضحى
en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: And We removed from you your burden

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: Which had weighed upon your back

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: And raised high for you your repute

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]

name: Ash-Sharh · الشرح
en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing
